name: PortfolioReviewRecord
description: Aggregate root for one periodic suitability review cycle for an HNW client. Tracks review status, meeting details, linked suitability assessment, rebalancing recommendation, and next review date. Introduced by JRN-015.

fields.name: client_id
fields.validation: FK to Customer (ENT-001, CAP-001); not null

fields.name: advisor_id
fields.validation: FK to Wealth Advisor identity (IAM); not null

fields.name: advisor_fca_register_ref
fields.validation: FCA Financial Services Register reference; not null

fields.name: status
fields.validation: scheduled | in_progress | suitability_pending | awaiting_client_instruction | execution_in_progress | reporting | completed | overdue | cancelled

fields.name: next_review_date
fields.validation: set at PH-076; must be within 12 months per COBS 9A

relationships.note: CAP-001 entity; referenced by client_id only
